name: burnt-out car wreck lying east-west seen from above: charred roof and hood, empty window frames, scorched rusty body on flat tyres
label: wasteland_ruins/car-burnt

surfaces.part: car body (roof, hood and boot seen from above)
tyres peeking out under the body

answer.evidence: The drawing is a plan view of the car. The charred roof, hood and boot fill rows 2-27 as one flat rusty surface, with dark window openings inside it and the wheel arches at the sides. No front-edge line or eave shadow marks a top plane above a south face. The body also has no vertical south face. The only vertical hint is a few rows of dark tyre at rows 27-30, under the body at the left and right ends, which is under 3 rows of real front face. The silhouette is nearly constant at 48 px wide from row 13 to row 24, as in a flat slab, so it reads as top_down_slab.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate measures 11 visible tones per 16x16 tile, above prop-hedge (9) and below the stall (17) and well (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no flat fills. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline leans dark brown or rust beside the body rather than being a black sticker line. The body shows several rust and char steps (about 5) with speckled grain, window frames and tyres separated mostly by value. It is a bit muddy and low in contrast, and slightly poorer than the stall and well, but it is on par with the hedge and a careful artist would accept it beside the references. Pass.
